title: Account Tier Rate: Professional Email Term Renewals
content:
The account-tier rate of a Professional Email term renewal is the email discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the tier recorded on the account on the charge date.

> A Microsoft 365 subscription takes no account-tier rate whatever the tier; otherwise a Harborline Reseller Platinum account takes the Platinum email discount percentage, a Harborline Reseller Gold account takes the Gold email discount percentage, a Harborline Reseller Silver account takes the Silver email discount percentage, a Harborline Reseller Bronze account takes the Bronze email discount percentage, and any other account takes no account-tier rate.

The account-tier rate reduces the renewal component of a term renewal once, before it is rounded; no other percentage is added to it or compounded with it, and it never reduces a fee or a credit.

| Subscription | Platinum, Gold, Silver or Bronze reseller account | Any other account |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail | that tier's email discount percentage | none |
| Microsoft 365 Business | none | none |

Example (hypothetical): the term renewal of a Harborline Mail Starter subscription held by a Harborline Reseller Gold account takes the Gold email discount percentage.
